item.title: We Did a Thing!
item.dc:creator: Blockfest Africa
item.content:encoded:
Hey Blockers,

Remember when we said July was going to be an interesting month?

Well…

August said, “Hold my drink.”

Because we did a thing.

We’re keeping this letter short because it’s finally the weekend, and frankly, the team is ready to:

  • Log off.

  • Recover from the week.

  • Do absolutely nothing for a little while.

But we couldn’t log off without telling you this first.

Blockfest Africa 2026 tickets are officially, formally, 100% LIVE.

No more “soon.”
No more “in the coming weeks.”
No more “stay tuned.”

It’s happening.

You Can Finally Get Your Ticket

And because we know some of you are already thinking:

“I’ll register later.”

No.

This is your sign to stop doing that.

For a limited time, you can get 25% off ALL tickets.

Yes.

Every. Single. One.

But there’s a catch (isn’t there always?).

The early-bird offer ends August 31st.

That means you can lock in your spot from just ₦7,500 before the prices go back up.

GRAB YOUR TICKET NOW

So… What Are You Actually Buying?

Three days of conversations, connections, and experiences around AI, Web3, fintech, innovation, policy, and the technologies shaping Africa’s next chapter.

Happening at the National Theatre, Lagos from October 22–23, 2026.

Expect:

  • Conversations that actually matter.

  • Deal-making opportunities for founders.

  • Workshops for creatives and builders.

  • Tech talent scouting.

  • New connections.

  • New ideas.

  • And probably a few “Wait, you’re here too?” moments.

And you can lock it all in for the price of a decent lunch 😉

Team (whispering silently into the audience’s ears): You might want to be in the room.

Because while the timeline will be busy talking about what happened…

You could actually be there.

The Clock Is Ticking

October is getting closer.

The early-bird discount is not staying forever.

And tickets?

Well, you already know how this goes.

You can either secure your spot now…

Or watch it all happen from the timeline.

Your call, Blocker.

Secure your seat from ₦7,500 before August 31st.

SECURE YOUR SEAT

See you on the inside,

— Amahra
Marketing Lead, Blockfest Africa

item.title: It's July O'Clock
item.dc:creator: Blockfest Africa
item.content:encoded:
Hey Blockers,

Quick question.
Wasn’t it January like... five minutes ago?

Because somehow we’re already in July, and that means half the year is gone.

Not that we were caught unaware; it’s just that the countdown is getting shorter.

Blockfest Africa Lagos used to feel “very far away,” but it’s no longer something that’s six months away.

Happy New Month, by the way.

We hope July brings good news, bold ideas, and maybe that one opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

Over here, we’ve been busy.

Very busy.

Endless meetings, ceaseless calls, planning sessions every now and then, before returning to more calls.

A few “this is going to be crazy” moments and several reminders that October is approaching faster than we’d like to admit.

The energy is building, the community is growing, and not only is the team getting ready, you are too.

Aren’t you?

Three months.
That’s all that’s standing between us and another unforgettable gathering in Lagos.

Not that we’re counting.
(Okay, we’re definitely counting.)

The countdown just feels different this time around.

A Little Reminder

If you’ve been thinking about attending Blockfest Africa Lagos 2026, this is your gentle reminder.

Start making plans now.

Need to tell your friends? Start telling them.

Coming with your team? Get them ready.

Objects in the mirror are closer than they appear.

So is October.

And trust us, you don’t want to hear about this one from someone else’s photos.

For Our Sponsors & Partners

Still thinking about partnering with us?

Our sponsorship conversations are still open.

If you’re building the future of anything here in Africa, we’d love to build this story together.

Reach us at partnership@blockfestafrica.com.

What’s Next?

While we can’t say much just yet...

We can tell you this:
July is going to be a very interesting month.

Catch you soon, Blockers.

— Amahra
Marketing Lead, Blockfest Africa

item.title: The Road Back to Lagos
item.dc:creator: Blockfest Africa
item.content:encoded:
Hey Blockers,

Remember when we told you to get your passports ready?

Some of you listened.

Some of you waited until the last minute.

And some of you probably still have “Renew Passport” sitting on a to-do list somewhere.

Either way, we made it.

Cape Town happened.

The conversations happened.

The collaborations happened.

The memories definitely happened.

And now that we’ve caught our breath, there’s something we’ve been meaning to tell you.

The road leads back to Lagos.

But before we get there, let’s talk about how far we’ve come.

Last Year Changed Everything

Around this time last year, Blockfest Africa was still an ambitious idea.

A very ambitious idea.

Could thousands of people from across Africa come together around a shared belief in technology, innovation, and the future?

Turns out they could.

Over 15,000 people registered.

More than 12,000 attended. 5,000+ showed up physically and 7,000+ joined virtually.

And somewhere between the conversations, keynotes, networking sessions, side events, and countless selfies, something bigger than an event was born.

A community.

One that refused to stop moving after the lights went off.

So We Took The Movement On The Road

This year, we wanted to try something different.

Not bigger.

Different.

Instead of waiting until October, we introduced the Blockfest Africa Roadshow.

Our first stop was Cape Town.

And what happened there reminded us why we started this in the first place.

Builders sharing ideas.

Founders finding collaborators.

Strangers becoming friends.

Communities connecting across borders.

No giant stage required.

Just the right people in the right room.

The roadshow wasn’t a replacement for the flagship Blockfest event.

It was proof that the movement could travel.

And Now...

We’re Coming Home.

On October 22nd and 23rd, Blockfest Africa returns to Lagos for our flagship event.

The city where thousands gathered.

The city where momentum became movement.

The city where we’re about to do it all again.

Only bigger.

Over the coming weeks, we’ll be sharing speaker announcements, partnerships, ecosystem collaborations, community opportunities, and a few surprises we’re not ready to talk about just yet.

Trust us.

You’ll want to stay close.

Calling All Sponsors & Partners

Quick question.

Want to put your brand in front of Africa’s biggest Web3 Festival?

Thought so.

We’re officially opening sponsorship and partnership conversations for Blockfest Africa Lagos 2026.

If your organization is building in Web3, AI, fintech, developer tooling, creator economy, digital infrastructure, or the future of technology in Africa, we’d love to explore how we can work together.

Because great events don’t happen alone.

And movements definitely don’t.

If you’d like to partner with us, reach out at partnership@blockfestafrica.com

Let’s build something meaningful together.

The Newsletter Is Back

We’ve been away for a minute, but we’re back!

From now until October, expect regular updates, ecosystem insights, behind-the-scenes stories, speaker reveals, partner spotlights, and everything happening on the road to Blockfest Africa Lagos.

The countdown has officially started.

Lagos is loading...

And if the last year taught us anything, it’s this:

The best stories are still ahead of us.

Catch you soon, Blockers.

— Amahra
Marketing Lead, Blockfest Africa

item.title: The Roadshow Is Live: Secure Your Spot
item.dc:creator: Blockfest Africa
item.content:encoded:
Hey Blockers,

Last time we spoke, we told you to get your passports ready.

We hope you listened because the moment is finally here.

Welcome to Blockfest Africa Roadshow: Cape Town, South Africa.

From May 5th to May 11th, the Blockfest community will gather in the Mother City for a week of connection, culture, and meaningful conversations.

Not a conference.

Not just another crypto meetup.

An experience.

Why Cape Town

Cape Town has quietly become one of the most exciting hubs for blockchain innovation in Africa.

Builders are experimenting.
Communities are growing.
Ideas are turning into real products.

And the energy coming out of South Africa has been impossible to ignore.

So instead of watching from afar, we decided to bring the Blockfest movement directly into that ecosystem.

Different city.
Different culture.
Same mission.

Buidl. Bridge. Become.

What The Roadshow Means

The Blockfest Africa Roadshow is exactly what it sounds like.

A journey.

Over several days, we will move through conversations, meetups, collaborations, and shared experiences with the people shaping Africa’s blockchain future.

Builders.
Founders.
Developers.
Investors.
Creators.
Curious newcomers.

Everyone has a seat on this journey.

Because Blockfest has never been just about stages and speakers. It has always been about the people in the room and the ideas that start there.

Just the right people, in the right spaces, having the right conversations.

And when the meetup ends, the experience continues.

For five days, the Blockfest community will then explore Cape Town together, turning conversations into real relationships while experiencing the city.

Think:

• The colorful streets of Bo-Kaap
• A sunset boat cruise at the V&A Waterfront
• The Table Mountain cable experience
• Quad biking across the Atlantis dunes
• The iconic Chapman’s Peak drive

Because sometimes the best ideas are born outside the conference room.

And this time, the entire city becomes part of the experience.

Tickets Are Now Live

And now the part many of you have been waiting for.

Tickets for Blockfest Africa Roadshow are officially available.

If you plan to be part of this experience, this is your moment to secure your spot. You already know how Blockfest moves.

Spots fill quickly
Energy travels fast
Opportunities tend to appear where we gather

There are three ways to join the experience:

General Admission
For those based in South Africa or making their own travel plans.

Roadshow Ticket + Tour Access
For independent travelers who want to join the official Cape Town experience.

All Inclusive Roadshow Package
Flights, accommodation, visa support, tours, and the full Blockfest experience.

However you choose to join, one thing is certain.

Cape Town is about to get very interesting.

Secure Your Ticket

Partnerships & Sponsorships

If your project or company would like to be part of the Blockfest Africa Roadshow, we would love to hear from you.

We are currently opening a limited number of sponsorship opportunities for brands looking to connect with Africa’s growing Web3 community.

If this sounds like you, or someone you know, reach out to us at partnership@blockfestafrica.com

Do not watch this one from the timeline.

Join us in Cape Town and be part of the movement.

See you there, Blockers.

With momentum,
Amahra
Marketing Lead, Blockfest Africa

item.title: 🌹 Roses Are Red. So Are the Candles.
item.dc:creator: Blockfest Africa
item.content:encoded:
Hey Blockers,

Yes, we’re saying it.

After months of suggestions, debates, and very passionate comments, the verdict was clear. You asked us to retire “BlockHeads,” and the name that kept coming up again and again was “Blockers.”

So from this letter forward, it’s official.

Welcome, Blockers.

And Happy Valentine’s Day ❤️

Now that we’ve settled that…

Roses are red. Violets are blue. Sugar is sweet. But this market? Not even close.

If it were, we would have sent each of you something special to unbox by now. Instead, most of us have been unboxing red candles.

The Market Doesn’t. But We Do.

All roses are red, but not everything red is a rose.

Lately, the market has been competing with roses, and it’s definitely not rosy.

The charts have not been kind lately. Portfolios are under pressure. Momentum feels slow. The excitement on the timeline has cooled down. Builders, founders, traders, creators, everyone can feel it.

This is usually the stage where people start questioning their conviction. Some get quiet. Some step back. Some disappear entirely.

But moments like this are part of the cycle.

And more than anything, what people need during times like this is love and reassurance. A reminder that their work still matters. That the value they are building is bigger than temporary charts.

The market does not care about morale.

But we do.

At Blockfest, we see the effort. We see the resilience. We see the builders who continue showing up even when the candles are red.

So consider this message our small Valentine’s reminder that you are seen, valued, and appreciated.

South Africa Is Close

Speaking of showing up…

If your passport is still “processing,” you might want to speed that up.

The next Blockfest Africa experience is heading to South Africa, and this is your reminder.

South Africa’s crypto community has contributed massively to Africa’s blockchain growth, and it’s time to connect more intentionally with that energy.

Different city. Different culture. Same mission.

Buidl. Bridge. Become.

Starting next week, we will be sharing back-to-back updates on our socials. Announcements, partnerships, ticket releases, and much more will start rolling out. Make sure your notifications are turned on. You do not want to miss a single update.

Stay close, stay connected, and stay ready.

Keeping It Short (It’s Valentine After All)

We’ll keep this brief. It is Valentine’s Day after all.

Today is not about charts or tickets. It’s about LOVE.

While the market may have withheld its affection lately, we haven’t.

If you’re reading this, know that you are bigger than any rose-y candles and temporary charts, and that you are part of something bigger.

Thank you for building with us.

Thank you for growing with us.

And once again…

Happy Valentine’s Day, Blockers.

With love,
Amahra
Marketing Lead, Blockfest Africa

item.title: Please Don't Say "Too Late"
item.dc:creator: Blockfest Africa
item.content:encoded:
Hey BlockHeads…

Wait. Let me say that properly.

Happy New Year, BlockHeads!

Yes, yes, we know. The year is already “three weeks gone.” But around here, time moves differently, because momentum never really stops. Still, we could have wished you earlier, and now that we finally are, please don’t say “too late.”

It has officially been three months since Blockfest Africa 2025 shut down the Landmark Event Centre and shook the ecosystem, and somehow, the momentum is still very much alive.

So let us catch up.

First, Thank You

Thousands of you have been block-ing with us since October.

Some of you were in the hall.

Some of you tuned in virtually.

Some of you watched the highlights later.

However you showed up, you’re part of the story now

Oh, and About the Family Name…

Over time, I have gone through your comments across our socials, and one thing was clear, you all did not hold back with the name suggestions. I saw everything, even one wild gem like “Blockers.” Whoever dropped that, we need to talk. I do not want to say it was Kiki.

And honestly, picking from those suggestions was harder than choosing a favorite Layer 1. But after going through everything, arguing internally and laughing a bit too much, we are sticking with BlockHeads for now.

Hey, do not blame us. We just cannot stop thinking in blocks.

Still, the door is open. If you feel you have got a name that hits harder, that carries the weight and identity of this movement, drop it in the comments. The block decides.

Now speaking of decisions…

Let’s Address the Elephant in the Room

We’ve spent the last few months reading DMs, comments, threads and yes, even one tear-stained voice note (you know yourself).

A lot of you were disappointed about not being selected or approved to attend. We intended to address this much earlier, but couldn’t at the time. Now that we’re finally saying it, please don’t say “too late.”

So let’s clear this up once and for all:

You were not rejected.

You were simply more than the hall could hold.

Over 15,000 people registered, while the venue could safely host 5,000 humans, 0.2 robots, and about 5 overwhelmed security guards.

If it were left to us, we would have opened the gates and let every builder in. But physics said no, the venue said absolutely not, and Lagos crowd control said do not even try it.

Next time, we’re thinking bigger halls, bigger screens, and bigger everything you wished we’d done. And yes, we mean that.

We know we could have communicated this earlier. We own that. And now that we have, please don’t say “too late.”

South Africa, You’re Up Next

Yes, the next Blockfest city is loading.

South Africa has been saying hello ever since we hinted at what is coming next.

If Lagos was the heartbeat, South Africa is what?

We are still thinking about that.

Renew that passport if it’s expired because the Mother City is calling.

Different vibe.

Different culture.

Same mission:

Buidl. Bridge. Become.

More details loading…

Meanwhile, the Ripple Effects Are Still Real

Since Blockfest Africa, here is what we have been seeing.

‣ Partnerships that started in queues are now full projects.

‣ Several attendees have secured internships, roles, and paid work.

‣ New startups have formed from strangers who met that day.

‣ And the media still will not stop calling.

This shows one thing clearly.

Blockfest is not just an event.

It is a movement with real momentum.

This Year’s Promise

2026 is the year Blockfest expands with more events, more cities, more access, more opportunities, and more seats at the table.

Most importantly, nobody left outside the door.

If Blockfest 2025 was ignition, 2026 is motion.

And we are only just getting started.

Alright BlockHea…

You know what? Let me not jinx it again.

Catch when next,

Amahra

Marketing Lead, Blockfest Africa

item.title: The Block’s Still Hot
item.dc:creator: Blockfest Africa
item.content:encoded:
Hey Blockheads,

Sounds fun, right? Don’t worry, not blockheads because we’re stuck 😅 but because we think in blocks, build in blocks, and together, we’re forming Africa’s strongest digital neighborhood.

(If you’re not feeling “Blockheads,” that’s cool too, hit reply and drop your own name suggestion. Let’s decide what to call ourselves as a community)

If you’re reading this, it means you were either part of something special, or you’ve just joined a community rewriting Africa’s digital story.

Y’all thought Blockfest ended at Landmark? Nah, the block’s still hot.

What started as Africa’s biggest Web3 festival has now evolved into Blockfest Newsletter, your new corner of the internet for real conversations, real opportunities, and real alpha.

A little secret: this isn’t another recap newsletter, it’s the afterparty that never ends.

What We’re Building Here

‣ Opportunities: grants, gigs, hackathons, and collaborations that can push your Web3 career or startup forward.

‣ Events: upcoming meetups, launches, and alpha spaces across Africa and beyond.

‣ Insights: distilled takes from the same founders, devs, and ecosystem leads who made Blockfest the Super Bowl of Web3.

If you’ve been in the space long enough, you know how loud the noise gets. Everyone’s shouting decentralization, but few are building direction. That’s what we’re changing here — clarity over chaos, and signal over noise.

Samuel Olaoyenikan (aka XeusTheGreat) said something during his keynote that hit deep:

“Excellence begets excellence.”

That’s the energy we’re bringing to this newsletter.

Every now and then, we’ll break down what’s really happening across the ecosystem, developer updates, investment trends, policy shifts, and ecosystem plays all through an African lens.

We’ll also spotlight underrated builders, highlight community wins, and drop occasional “builders-only alpha” (you know… the kind that doesn’t make it to X 👀).

Upcoming Partner Events

1️⃣ Sui-nami Lagos Meetup
The biggest Sui Blockchain Community Event is happening in Lagos!
Meet your favorite ecosystem projects, KOLs, creators, and community members.

Date: November 15, 2025
Time: 10 AM
Location: Lagos
Register here — you don’t want to miss out.

2️⃣ Sub0: Polkadot Global Builder Party Hackathon

Polkadot’s global Builders Party lands in Argentina!
A highly immersive three-day Polkadot flagship summit in Burnos Aires in November. Will include;

  • 60 curated Speakers

  • Rooftop Beach

  • 13 Live Experiences

  • 25+ side Events

  • … and many more

🎁 Earn exclusive POAPs & merch
💰 Compete for $40,000+ in global hackathon prizes
🤝 Network with builders, founders, and open-source contributors

Date: November 14–16, 2025
Location: Argentina
Join the Builders Party for Sub0!

So yeah, the event may be over, but the mission’s just getting started.

This is where Africa’s Web3 conversation lives now.

Welcome to Blockfest Newsletter — the pulse, the playbook, the platform.

Catch you next week, Blockheads
— Amahra
Marketing Lead, Blockfest Africa
